production_patch_candidates.title: Fail fast / surface decision-backend unavailability at launch
production_patch_candidates.change: before opening any session, probe the decision backend once (the composition-side preflight in .work/engagement-diagnosis/engagement_window34.py is the reference implementation: build_decision_request from a minimal BotState, one decide() call) and refuse to launch with the error class named
production_patch_candidates.why: w32 burned 1800s and reported passed:true while every brain call failed

production_patch_candidates.title: Do not tear down an authenticated game session when only the brain review fails
production_patch_candidates.change: isolate the brain-start decision failure from the transport lifecycle: catch the decision/chat backend exception around self._start_brain() separately from connect()'s BaseException cleanup, keep the (already authenticated) client connected with the brain unreviewed, and let the next event/heartbeat review when the backend recovers; minimally, add a retry budget with backoff so a down backend cannot produce infinite 30s-cadence full relogins
production_patch_candidates.why: today a decision outage converts into permanent relogin churn (29-30 map joins/agent/1800s observed), which also poisons the journal interpretation and starves the keepalive/pacer machinery; NOTE this is a behavior-policy change (online-without-review vs fail-closed) for the parent to decide under TDD
production_patch_candidates.policy_note: fail-closed teardown is defensible (never fake progress); if kept, then priority 1 (fast preflight) plus a bounded retry/backoff is the minimal honest hardening

production_patch_candidates.title: Pace on wall time, not loop iterations
production_patch_candidates.change: HeartbeatPacer accumulates fixed step_s per step() call regardless of wall time; with a slow host.step (here ~60s/iteration) the cadence silently collapses. Accumulate measured elapsed time (or only count iterations that advanced the clock)
production_patch_candidates.why: w32's pacer accumulated 7.5s of cadence in a 1800s window; even with a healthy backend a slow loop would starve reviews the same way

production_patch_candidates.title: Plan survival across epoch changes (secondary, becomes live once sessions survive)
production_patch_candidates.change: sync_context wipes _plan on every native-epoch change and _run_review overwrites brain._plan on every review; with full relogin per warp, an authored plan dies at each map change until the next heartbeat re-authors it (offline this self-heals at pacer cadence; across relogin churn it is a starvation window). If plan persistence across warps is desired, re-pin from the operator seam after epoch changes or make _setup_farm_plan reuse a compatible prior plan
production_patch_candidates.why: the reset-state agent falls back to NpcGuidanceScript/exploration (never attacks) between plan loss and the next completed review
